results.title: UK buys £1bn Nigerian oil as Dangote refinery expands
results.snippet:
The new import restrictions, which came into force on 20 May, are aimed at closing the so-called “refining loophole” that allowed countries to refine Russian crude into products such as gasoline, diesel, and jet fuel before exporting them to Western markets.
